entities.name: I1RZ92 IDI1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Gibberella zeae isopentenyl-diphosphate delta-isomerase (IDI1); EC 5.3.3.2.
Catalyzes reversible isomerization of isopentenyl diphosphate (IPP) to dimethylallyl diphosphate (DMAPP); curated reference lists Rhea RHEA:23284.
Reference annotation reports one Mg2+ bound per subunit.

entities.name: IPP-DMAPP isomerization
observations: Isopentenyl diphosphate ⇌ dimethylallyl diphosphate; 1,3-allylic rearrangement, EC 5.3.3.2, Rhea RHEA:23284.

entities.name: Isoprenoid biosynthesis
observations: IDI1 catalyzes the IPP-to-DMAPP step that supplies an activated allylic isoprenoid building block for downstream prenyl-diphosphate and sterol biosynthesis.
